title: Show the TermAl host's actual refusal reason when Engram's test launcher registration POST is refused, instead of a generic "unconfirmed/refused"
outcome: Show the TermAl host's actual refusal reason when Engram's test launcher registration POST is refused, instead of a generic "unconfirmed/refused"
acceptance: When the TermAl host refuses a test-run registration POST, Engram's launcher reports the host's bounded refusal reason (status and message) in its admission output and run metadata, instead of only a generic unconfirmed/refused state
A launcher test covers a refused registration response and asserts that the reason is preserved and bounded, with no secret or unbounded body echoed

completion.summary: Preserved bounded HTTP status and host refusal message in launcher metadata and output, with explicit unavailable-message fallback and regression coverage. Exact reviewed candidate landed, pushed and installed with all six stores ready.
